retention.reason: Preserve benchmark integrity and avoid publishing evaluation text in a crawlable repository.

selection.ordering: source BCP-47 then target BCP-47 then sha256(seed || direction || source-line || target-line), ascending; directions remain contiguous for bounded aligned batches
selection.terminologyRule: first 75 selected cases with one or more exact case-folded Latin technical tokens shared by source and reference after stable global ordering
selection.subtitleRule: first 75 selected cases after stable global ordering; the input remains one ordered segment and the evaluator requires one ordered output segment
selection.numericEntityRule: all selected cases containing a Unicode decimal token; at least 100 cases are required, and each source numeric multiset is compared directly with the candidate output

metrics.segmentAlignment: output array length and order exactly match input
